realms.name: Isle of Dawn
realms.description: A calm starting realm where new players learn the basics of Sky.

realms.name: Daylight Prairie
realms.description: A bright and open realm filled with grasslands and peaceful landscapes.

realms.name: Hidden Forest
realms.description: A rainy forest realm where players must protect their light.

realms.description: A snowy realm known for flying, racing, and beautiful mountain views.
